after.client_desc: Increases your damage with Wands by $s1%.
Improves your chance to hit with Arcane spells by $s1%.
Gives you a $m1% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling Arcane Missiles and a $m2% chance while casting Arcane Blast.
Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by $s2 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by $s1%.
Increases all your resistances by $s2 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore $s1% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.
Gives you a $m1% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target.  The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by $/10;12536s1%.
Increases your Armor by an amount equal to $s1% of your Intellect.
Increases the range of your Arcane spells by $m1 yards.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by $m1%.

Blasts the target with energy, dealing $s1 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, the damage of all your other spells is increased by $400573s1% and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by $400573s2%. Effect stacks up to $400573u times and lasts $400573d or until any other damage spell is cast.
Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by $m1% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by $m2%.
Your Counterspell also Silences the target for ${$m1/1000} sec.
Allows $s1% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Gives your Arcane Blast spell a $m1% chance, and your Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a ${$m1/2}% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by $400589s1%, reduce the Mana cost by $400589s3%, and missiles fire every ${$m2/10}.1 sec.

after.client_desc: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.
Increases your Intellect by $m1% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by $m2%.
Increases the damage done by your spells by $m1% and your critical strike chance by $m2%.
For the next $d, your spells deal $s1% more damage while costing $s2% more mana to cast.
Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by ${$s1/-1000} sec. Killing a non-trivial target increases the critical strike chance of your next Fire Blast cast within $1312934d by $m2%.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast, and Scorch spells by $s1%.
Reduces the casting time of your Fireball and Frostfire Bolt spells by $/1000;S1 sec.
Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional $m1% of your spell's damage over $412538d.
Increases the range of your Fire spells by $s1 yards.

after.client_desc: Gives your Fire spells a $m1% chance to stun the target for $12355d.
Gives your Fire spells a $s1% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by $s2%.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike spell by $s1%.
Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes $s1 Fire damage and an additional $o2 Fire damage over $d.

after.client_desc: Your Scorch spell has a $m1% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by $22959s1% and lasts $22959d, stacking up to $22959u times.
Causes your Fire Ward to have a $s1% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.

after.client_desc: Your non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch grant Hot Streak for $400625d. Hot Streak reduces the cast time of Pyroblast by $400625s1%, stacking up to $400625s2 times.
Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund $s1% of their base mana cost.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by $s1%.
A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for $s1 Fire damage, and Dazing them for $s2% reduced movement speed for $d.
Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by $s1%.

When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by $28682s1%.  This effect lasts until you have caused $n non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.
Increases the Armor and resistance given by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by $s1%. In addition, gives your Frost Ward a $s2% chance to reflect Frost spells and effects while active.
Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by $/1000;S1 sec.
Improves your chance to hit with Frost and Fire spells by $s1%.
Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by $s1%.
Increases the duration of your Chill effects by $s1% and reduces the target's speed by an additional $s2%.
Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova spell by $/1000;s1 sec.
Gives your Chill effects a $s1% chance to Freeze the target for $12494d.
Increases the damage done by your Frost spells by $s1%.
Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by $s1% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by $s2%.
Deals $s1 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals $s2% increased damage to Frozen targets.

after.client_desc: Adds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by $m1% for $12484d.
Increases the range of your Frostbolt and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by $s1%.
You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for $d, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.
Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by $m1%.
Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by $s1%.
Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.
Gives your Chill effects a $s2% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next $m1 $lspell:spells; cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts $400669d.

Gives your Frost damage spells a $m2% chance to apply the Winter's Chill effect, which increases the chance your Ice Lance and Frostbolt spells will critically hit the target by $12579s1% for $12579d. Stacks up to $s1 times.
Instantly shields you, absorbing $s1 damage. Lasts $d. While the shield holds, your spellcasts will not be interrupted or delayed from taking damage.
